newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BB Industrie NAV up 14 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: BB Industrie NAV up 14 pct in Q1.

text.p: Swiss investment company BB Industrie Holding AG said on Wednesday the net asset value (NAV) of its shares rose 14 percent in the first quarter to 2,912 Swiss francs on March 31.
The firm said it made a group net profit of 90 million francs, mainly due to the sale of stakes in Rieter Holding AG and Spanish steel company Acerinox.
The share capital of BB Industrie, which invests in engineering companies, amounted to 728 million francs, the company said in a statement.
BB Industrie disposed of net liquidity of 325 million francs and it is currently examining various alternatives, but so far no decisions had been made on how to use the money.
BB Industrie added it expanded its stake in Saurer by 38,315 shares during the first quarter and it now owns a total of 497,967 shares for a stake in Saurer of 32 percent.
It added that shareholders on April 4 approved a reduction in the nominal value of its bearer shares to 10 francs from 90, resulting in a payback to shareholders of 22.5 million francs.
